title: Restricted-weight free sign assignments
statement: Let $n$ be the dimension of a restricted-weight input and let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. For each index in the sample set determined by the inner input, convert the corresponding projected binary sample into a sign assignment on $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the input's coordinate indices
